About the work from home job/internship

As a software development intern at NayePankh Foundation, you will have the opportunity to work on exciting projects that make a real impact on society. Your skills in HTML, Java, MySQL, CSS, JavaScript, Python, .NET, Node.js, C++ Programming, React, and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) will be put to the test as you collaborate with our team of experienced developers.

Selected intern's day-to-day responsibilities include:

1. Assist in the design and development of web applications using a variety of programming languages and technologies.
2. Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot and debug issues in existing software systems.
3. Participate in code reviews and provide feedback on best practices for coding standards.
4. Research and implement new technologies to enhance the functionality of our software products.
5. Work closely with project managers to ensure that software projects are delivered on time and within budget.
6. Contribute to the documentation of software design, development, and maintenance processes.
7. Stay up-to-date on the latest trends and developments in software development to continuously improve your skills and knowledge.

If you are a motivated and enthusiastic individual with a passion for technology and a desire to make a difference, we want to hear from you. Join us at NayePankh Foundation and be a part of our mission to empower communities through innovative software solutions.

Skill(s) required

.NET C++ Programming CSS Effective Communication HTML Java JavaScript MySQL Node.js Python React Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
